question_text: Outline how to recognize the final node of a nonempty circular singly linked list with an external head reference.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: The final node is the node whose next reference points back to the same node as head; its next reference is not None.
